name: instructional-design-studio
description: Twelve complete lesson, curriculum, assessment, access and learning-experience workflows with 31 original assessment adaptations. Private Atlas bindings and restricted source archives are excluded; source attributions retained.

interface.shortDescription: Design lessons and assessments that teach a skill
interface.longDescription: Twelve complete skills for learning design, needs analysis, curriculum, learning experiences, lessons, knowledge assessment, assignments, accessibility, AI literacy, evaluation and production. Includes a searchable archive of 31 source-linked activity adaptations, source-grounded item authoring, scoring checks and distinct Survey Studio routing. Use one specialist and only the references needed for the current deliverable.
defaultPrompt: Create a source-grounded knowledge check with scoring and feedback.
Find a playful learning activity with individual evidence and a retry.
Design an assignment with a clear rubric and scoring examples.
